correctness.rationale: For m>=3 the P(m,2) halfspace model has o,a_i,b_ij as its m^2+1 simple vertices and exactly the four listed edge families, each vertex degree m. In L, the B_{ij} zero-row/column space decomposes into symmetric and antisymmetric dimensions m(m-3)/2 and (m-1)(m-2)/2, with eigenvalues m,m+2. Its complement splits into scalar T_m and m-1 standard M_m blocks, whose explicitly computed determinant factors account for the entire dimension. Kirchhoff cancels the scalar nonzero product m^2+1 to yield the formula. Signs of cubic at 1 and 1+1/m, monotonicity below 2, and the quadratic/root alternatives justify the unique spectral-gap root. Independent exact constructed Laplacians for m=3,4 gave matching full characteristic polynomials and grounded cofactors 1445 and 60742656; finite tests are corroborative, not a proof of all m.
